caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet made of fabric, shown in profile and oriented toward the left. The bonnet has a rounded crown with a faint crosshatch texture and is adorned with horizontal bands of trim or ribbon near the base. There is a cluster of ornamental details, possibly floral or ribbon decorations, attached to the right side, partly obscuring the band. Two long, narrow ribbons extend downward from the bonnet’s lower edge, trailing to the right side of the composition. The bonnet also features lace or embroidered fabric at the front, forming two triangular flaps with scalloped edges that hang downward. The drawing uses fine, detailed pencil or ink lines on a plain, beige background, with some light shading and a subtle yellow tint on the lace or fabric flaps.
